assessment: This paper describes an inexpensive but very powerful microfluidic approach to quantitatively determine the viscoelastic properties of living cells from their deformation in a flow. Its implementation seems simple so that even people not specialized in cell mechanics can use it, and the method offers the possibility to perform measurements on a large number of cells (up to 50-100 per second). The data are compelling and this technique should set a new standard in the field.
